Packages a finite family of complex terms with a closed pointwise budget, then
instantiates it for all non-all-equal CGL fibre rows.  The subtype carrier keeps
the finite off-diagonal condition certified, avoiding repeated expansion of the
cubic filtered sum during later source-level estimates.
-/

import GaloisForLFunctions.RHTower.ChenGuptaLiLemma45FibreZeroModeBound

open scoped BigOperators FourierTransform

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- A finite complex family with one certified uniform real norm budget. -/
structure CGLFiniteComplexBudget (α : Type*) where
  index : Finset α
  term : α → ℂ
  budget : ℝ
  point_bound (a : α) : a ∈ index → ‖term a‖ ≤ budget

namespace CGLFiniteComplexBudget

/-- Sum of the finite complex family. -/
def value {α : Type*} (B : CGLFiniteComplexBudget α) : ℂ :=
  ∑ a ∈ B.index, B.term a

/-- Sum of the uniform real budget over the same finite index set. -/
def totalBudget {α : Type*} (B : CGLFiniteComplexBudget α) : ℝ :=
  ∑ _a ∈ B.index, B.budget

/-- Triangle inequality for a certified finite complex budget. -/
theorem norm_value_le_totalBudget {α : Type*}
    (B : CGLFiniteComplexBudget α) :
    ‖B.value‖ ≤ B.totalBudget := by
  unfold value totalBudget
  refine le_trans (norm_sum_le _ _) ?_
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a ha
  exact B.point_bound a ha

/-- Exact closed form for the total of a uniform finite budget. -/
theorem totalBudget_eq_card_mul {α : Type*}
    (B : CGLFiniteComplexBudget α) :
    B.totalBudget = (B.index.card : ℝ) * B.budget := by
  simp [totalBudget]

end CGLFiniteComplexBudget

/-- The finite certified family of all non-all-equal CGL fibre zero-mode row
terms, with its arbitrary-order reciprocal-decay budget. -/
def cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget
    {q R : ℕ} (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R)
    (w : CGLRealSmoothBump) (N : CGLPositiveLength) (n : ℕ) :
    CGLFiniteComplexBudget (CGLLemma45FibreOffDiagonalTriple R) := by
  letI : Fintype (CGLLemma45FibreOffDiagonalTriple R) :=
    cglLemma45FibreOffDiagonalTripleFintype R
  exact
    { index := Finset.univ
      term := fun u => cglLemma45ZeroModeRowTerm w N (cglLemma45FibreModulus q) R
        (cglLemma45FibreRows P) u.1
      budget := cglLemma45FibreZeroModeRowBound P w N n
      point_bound := fun u _ => norm_cglLemma45FibreOffDiagonalZeroModeRow_le P w N n u }

/-- Closed finite aggregation of the CGL Lemma 4.5 zero-frequency row bounds. -/
theorem norm_cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudgetValue_le
    {q R : ℕ} (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R)
    (w : CGLRealSmoothBump) (N : CGLPositiveLength) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n).value‖ ≤
      (cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n).totalBudget :=
  CGLFiniteComplexBudget.norm_value_le_totalBudget
    (cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n)

/-- Exact cardinal-times-row-budget form of the finite CGL zero-mode total. -/
theorem cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget_totalBudget_eq
    {q R : ℕ} (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R)
    (w : CGLRealSmoothBump) (N : CGLPositiveLength) (n : ℕ) :
    (cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n).totalBudget =
      ((cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n).index.card : ℝ) *
        cglLemma45FibreZeroModeRowBound P w N n :=
  CGLFiniteComplexBudget.totalBudget_eq_card_mul
    (cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n)

/-- Exact reindexing from CGL's literal filtered off-diagonal row sum to the
certified subtype aggregate. -/
theorem cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFilteredSum_eq_budgetValue
    {q R : ℕ} (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R)
    (w : CGLRealSmoothBump) (N : CGLPositiveLength) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ rst ∈ (cglCharacterDyadicGramCubicIndexSet R).filter
        (fun rst => ¬ (rst.1 = rst.2.1 ∧ rst.2.1 = rst.2.2)),
      cglLemma45ZeroModeRowTerm w N (cglLemma45FibreModulus q) R
        (cglLemma45FibreRows P) rst =
      (cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n).value := by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (CGLLemma45FibreOffDiagonalTriple R) :=
    cglLemma45FibreOffDiagonalTripleFintype R
  unfold cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget CGLFiniteComplexBudget.value
  apply Finset.sum_subtype
  intro rst
  simp [cglCharacterDyadicGramCubicIndexSet]

/-- Exact identification of the CGL Lemma 4.5 off-diagonal origin term with
its certified finite zero-mode aggregate. -/
theorem cglLemma45OffDiagonalFrequencyTerm_zero_eq_budgetValue
    {q R : ℕ} (P : CGLFibreSeparatedPacket q R)
    (w : CGLRealSmoothBump) (N : CGLPositiveLength) (n : ℕ) :
    cglLemma45OffDiagonalFrequencyTerm w N (cglLemma45FibreModulus q) R
      (cglLemma45FibreRows P) 0 =
      (cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFiniteBudget P w N n).value := by
  rw [cglLemma45OffDiagonalFrequencyTerm_zero_eq_sum_zeroModeRowTerm]
  exact cglLemma45FibreZeroModeFilteredSum_eq_budgetValue P w N n

/-- Closed finite bound for the literal zero-frequency CGL off-diagonal term. -/

tripLZero q) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.Gamma (w + 1) * cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient X q z w

/-- Away from `w = 0`, the original non-principal detector Mellin integrand
is exactly its regularized analytic replacement. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalMellinIntegrand_eq_regularized_off_zero (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    cglDetectorMellinIntegrand X q z.toCGLCriticalStripLZero w =
      cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand X q z w := by
  rw [show cglDetectorMellinIntegrand X q z.toCGLCriticalStripLZero w =
    Complex.Gamma w * cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor X q z w by rfl,
    cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_eq_mul_zeroQuotient,
    cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand]
  rw [Complex.Gamma_add_one w hw]
  ring

/-- The regularized non-principal Mellin integrand is analytic at the former
Gamma pole `w = 0`. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand_analyticAt_zero (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand X q z) 0 := by
  unfold cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand
  apply AnalyticAt.mul
  · exact (HTGeometry.analyticAt_Gamma_of_re_pos (by norm_num)).comp
      (analyticAt_id.add analyticAt_const)
  · exact cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient_analyticAt X q z 0

/-- The half-plane in which the regularized Gamma factor `Γ(w+1)` is
analytic. -/
def cglGammaSafeHalfPlane : Set ℂ := {w | (-1 : ℝ) < w.re}

/-- A certified finite rectangle for the non-principal detector shift.  It
contains the cancelled Gamma pole at zero while remaining in the half-plane
where its regularization is analytic. -/
structure CGLNonprincipalDetectorRectangle where
  lower : ℂ
  upper : ℂ
  lower_re_gt_neg_one : (-1 : ℝ) < lower.re
  lower_re_lt_zero : lower.re < 0
  zero_re_lt_upper : 0 < upper.re
  lower_im_lt_zero : lower.im < 0
  zero_im_lt_upper : 0 < upper.im

/-- The regularized non-principal integrand is analytic on the entire safe
Gamma half-plane. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand_analyticOnGammaSafe (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand X q z)
      cglGammaSafeHalfPlane := by
  intro w hw
  unfold cglGammaSafeHalfPlane at hw
  unfold cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand
  apply AnalyticAt.mul
  · change AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => Complex.Gamma (u + 1)) w
    have hpos : 0 < (w + 1).re := by
      change (-1 : ℝ) < w.re at hw
      rw [Complex.add_re]
      norm_num
      linarith
    have hshift : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u + 1) w := by
      exact (analyticAt_id.add analyticAt_const : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun u : ℂ => u + 1) w)
    have hcomp := AnalyticAt.comp (g := Complex.Gamma) (f := fun u : ℂ => u + 1)
      (HTGeometry.analyticAt_Gamma_of_re_pos hpos) hshift
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  · exact cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient_analyticAt X q z w

/-- The closed rectangle supplied by a non-principal rectangle certificate
lies in the safe Gamma half-plane. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorRectangle_subset_gammaSafe
    (r : CGLNonprincipalDetectorRectangle) :
    (uIcc r.lower.re r.upper.re ×ℂ uIcc r.lower.im r.upper.im) ⊆
      cglGammaSafeHalfPlane := by
  intro w hw
  rw [Complex.mem_reProdIm] at hw
  unfold cglGammaSafeHalfPlane
  have hre : r.lower.re ≤ r.upper.re := by
    linarith [r.lower_re_lt_zero, r.zero_re_lt_upper]
  rw [uIcc_of_le hre] at hw
  rw [mem_Icc] at hw
  exact r.lower_re_gt_neg_one.trans_le hw.1.1

/-- The lower horizontal edge of a certified non-principal rectangle avoids
the cancelled pole at zero. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorRectangle_bottom_ne_zero
    (r : CGLNonprincipalDetectorRectangle) (x : ℝ)
    (_hx : x ∈ uIcc r.lower.re r.upper.re) :
    (x : ℂ) + r.lower.im * I ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_add, mul_one, zero_im] at him
  linarith [r.lower_im_lt_zero]

/-- The upper horizontal edge of a certified non-principal rectangle avoids
the cancelled pole at zero. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorRectangle_top_ne_zero
    (r : CGLNonprincipalDetectorRectangle) (x : ℝ)
    (_hx : x ∈ uIcc r.lower.re r.upper.re) :
    (x : ℂ) + r.upper.im * I ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have him := congrArg Complex.im h
  simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, zero_add, mul_one, zero_im] at him
  linarith [r.zero_im_lt_upper]

/-- The right vertical edge of a certified non-principal rectangle avoids
the cancelled pole at zero. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorRectangle_right_ne_zero
    (r : CGLNonprincipalDetectorRectangle) (y : ℝ)
    (_hy : y ∈ uIcc r.lower.im r.upper.im) :
    (r.upper.re : ℂ) + y * I ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re h

/-!
# Gamma-cell periodic nonreal mobility universality law

Real-zero-free nonreal strip mobility and the periodicity dichotomy are compatible in only one
way: the mobile off-line zero cannot enter the dichotomy's critical-line branch, so it must expand
to a full two-sided vertical progression.  The result is first proved for any carrier class and
then specialized to the gamma-completed cell.
-/

open Complex

namespace RHTower

noncomputable section

/-- A class has periodic real-zero-free nonreal strip mobility when one member has no real
open-strip zero but carries a nonreal off-line zero whose full vertical arithmetic progression
also consists of zeros. -/
def RealZeroFreeNonrealPeriodicStripMobility (C : (ℂ → ℂ) → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ f : ℂ → ℂ, ∃ ρ : ℂ, ∃ T : ℝ, C f ∧
    (∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → f (σ : ℂ) ≠ 0) ∧
    0 < ρ.re ∧ ρ.re < 1 ∧ ρ.im ≠ 0 ∧ ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2 ∧
    0 < T ∧ ∀ k : ℤ, f (ρ + (k * T) * Complex.I) = 0

/-- **Abstract periodic-mobility law.**  If every member of a mobile carrier class satisfies the
periodicity dichotomy, real-zero-free nonreal mobility necessarily upgrades to a full off-line
vertical zero progression. -/
theorem realZeroFreeNonrealStripMobility_promotes_to_periodic
    (C : (ℂ → ℂ) → Prop)
    (hmobility : RealZeroFreeNonrealStripMobility C)
    (hdichotomy : ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, C f → PeriodicityDichotomy f) :
    RealZeroFreeNonrealPeriodicStripMobility C := by
  rcases hmobility with
    ⟨f, ρ, hf, hrealFree, hρ0, hρ1, hρnonreal, hzero, hρoffLine⟩
  rcases hdichotomy f hf ρ hρ0 hρ1 hzero with hline | ⟨T, hT, hperiodic⟩
  · exact (hρoffLine hline).elim
  · exact ⟨f, ρ, T, hf, hrealFree, hρ0, hρ1, hρnonreal,
      hρoffLine, hT, hperiodic⟩

/-- **Gamma-cell periodic nonreal mobility universality law.**  A cell-wide periodicity dichotomy
does not collapse gamma-cell mobility onto the critical line.  It forces existence of an all-prime
cell member that is zero-free on the real strip and carries a full nonreal off-line vertical
progression of zeros. -/
theorem gammaFECell_periodic_nonreal_mobility_of_dichotomy
    (hdichotomy : ∀ f : ℂ → ℂ, GammaFECell f → PeriodicityDichotomy f) :
    RealZeroFreeNonrealPeriodicStripMobility GammaFECell := by
  exact realZeroFreeNonrealStripMobility_promotes_to_periodic
    GammaFECell gammaFECell_real_zero_free_nonreal_strip_mobility hdichotomy

end

end RHTower

/-!
# Actual theta approximation axioms do not select real finite divisors

The signed theta completion chooses each finite stage using four recorded properties: finite
support, Hilbert--Schmidt regularity, prescribed approximation accuracy, and zero diagonal trace.
Those properties are spectrally nonselective.

At every requested accuracy, the arbitrary-target density theorem supplies another admissible
stage having an explicit nonreal ordinary Fredholm zero. This does not say the fixed
`Classical.choice` stage has a nonreal divisor. It proves that its recorded specification cannot
yield real-divisor or modewise Green-neutrality theorems. A successful replacement must record an
additional theta-arithmetic flag or boundary law.
-/

open Complex Matrix

namespace RHTower.HedenmalmThetaSource

open HilbertSchmidt GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry

noncomputable section

/-- Every theta approximation accuracy admits a finite-support traceless source stage satisfying
the existing stage specification but carrying a nonreal ordinary Fredholm divisor. -/
theorem exists_thetaSourceSignedApproximationProperty_nonrealDivisor (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (SK : Finset thetaIndex × (thetaIndex × thetaIndex → ℂ)) (z : ℂ),
      ThetaSourceSignedApproximationProperty k SK ∧
      ((1 : Matrix ↥SK.1 ↥SK.1 ℂ) - z • blockMatrix SK.2 SK.1).det = 0 ∧
      z.im ≠ 0 := by
  have hε : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  obtain ⟨s, K', z, hsupp, hHS, hclose, htrace, hdet, him⟩ :=
    exists_finiteSupport_traceZero_nonrealDivisor_close
      isHS_neg_thetaKernelMatrix hε
  exact ⟨⟨s, K'⟩, z, ⟨hsupp, hHS, hclose, htrace⟩, hdet, him⟩

/-- Closed source-specific nonselection certificate: every current approximation fibre contains a
stage with a nonreal divisor. -/
theorem thetaSourceSignedApproximationProperty_spectrally_nonselective :
    ∀ k : ℕ,
      ∃ (SK : Finset thetaIndex × (thetaIndex × thetaIndex → ℂ)) (z : ℂ),
        ThetaSourceSignedApproximationProperty k SK ∧
        ((1 : Matrix ↥SK.1 ↥SK.1 ℂ) - z • blockMatrix SK.2 SK.1).det = 0 ∧
        z.im ≠ 0 :=
  exists_thetaSourceSignedApproximationProperty_nonrealDivisor

end

end RHTower.HedenmalmThetaSource

/-!
# Analyticity of Suzuki's arithmetic carrier Herglotz transform

This file differentiates the normalized arithmetic carrier transform under
its defining integral.  The derivative is the density-weighted squared
resolvent, and the transform is analytic on the complement of the real axis.
This also supplies the confluent value of the carrier Pick kernel when the
two spectral parameters collide after reflection.

No boundary limit, tail vanishing, or RH conclusion is asserted here.
-/

open Asymptotics Complex Filter MeasureTheory Metric Polynomial Set Topology
open scoped Classical ComplexConjugate ENNReal Topology lp

namespace RiemannGaussian

noncomputable section

/-- The squared resolvent occurring as the parameter derivative of the
normalized Cauchy kernel. -/
def suzukiXiSquaredResolvent (z : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  1 / (((x : ℂ) - z) ^ 2)

/-- The real-boundary squared resolvent is absolutely integrable for every
nonreal parameter. -/
theorem integrable_suzukiXiSquaredResolvent
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (suzukiXiSquaredResolvent z) := by
  have hgap :
      (1 : ℂ[X]).natDegree + 2 ≤ ((X - C z) ^ 2).natDegree := by
    have hden : ((X - C z) ^ 2).natDegree = 2 := by
      compute_degree
      norm_num
    rw [hden]
    norm_num
  have hreal : ∀ x : ℝ, ((X - C z) ^ 2).eval (x : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro x
    simp only [eval_pow, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (ofReal_sub_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero hz x)
  have h := polynomialBoundaryQuotient_integrable_of_natDegree_add_two_le
    hgap hreal
  apply h.congr
  exact Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by
    simp [suzukiXiSquaredResolvent]

/-- The density-weighted squared resolvent that will be the derivative
integrand of the arithmetic carrier transform. -/
def suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzDerivativeIntegrand
    (z : ℂ) (x : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  (suzukiXiRealAxisArithmeticCarrierDensity x : ℂ) *
    suzukiXiSquaredResolvent z x

/-- The derivative integrand is absolutely integrable at every nonreal
parameter. -/
theorem integrable_suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzDerivativeIntegrand
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    Integrable (suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzDerivativeIntegrand z) := by
  have hdensity : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ ↦
      (suzukiXiRealAxisArithmeticCarrierDensity x : ℂ)) :=
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.measurable.comp
      measurable_suzukiXiRealAxisArithmeticCarrierDensity).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
      ‖(suzukiXiRealAxisArithmeticCarrierDensity x : ℂ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (suzukiXiRealAxisArithmeticCarrierDensity_nonneg x)]
      exact suzukiXiRealAxisArithmeticCarrierDensity_le_one x
  exact (integrable_suzukiXiSquaredResolvent hz).bdd_mul
    hdensity hbound

/-- Pointwise differentiation of the normalized Cauchy kernel with respect
to its nonreal parameter. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_suzukiXiNormalizedCauchyKernel
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ suzukiXiNormalizedCauchyKernel w x)
      (suzukiXiSquaredResolvent z x) z := by
  unfold suzukiXiNormalizedCauchyKernel suzukiXiSquaredResolvent
  have hxz := ofReal_sub_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero hz x
  have hlinear : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ (x : ℂ) - w) (-1) z :=
    (hasDerivAt_id' z).const_sub (x : ℂ)
  have hinverse := hlinear.inv hxz
  simpa [one_div] using
    hinverse.sub_const ((x : ℂ) / (1 + (x : ℂ) ^ 2))

/-- Pointwise differentiation of the arithmetic carrier Herglotz integrand
with respect to its nonreal parameter. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzIntegrand
    {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ ↦ suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzIntegrand w x)
      (suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzDerivativeIntegrand z x) z := by
  unfold suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzIntegrand
    suzukiXiCarrierHerglotzDerivativeIntegrand
  exact (hasDerivAt_suzukiXiNormalizedCauchyKernel hz x).const_mul _

/-- On the half-height ball around a nonreal parameter, every squared
resolvent is bounded by four times the squared resolvent at the center. -/
theorem norm_suzukiXiSquaredResolvent_le_four_mul
    {z w : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0)
    (hw : w ∈ ball z (|z.im| / 2)) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖suzukiXiSquaredResolvent w x‖ ≤
      4 * ‖suzukiXiSquaredResolvent z x‖ := by
  have hxz : (x : ℂ) - z ≠ 0 :=
    ofReal_sub_ne_zero_of_im_ne_zero hz x
  have hheight : |z.im| ≤ ‖(x : ℂ) - z‖ := by
    simpa only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_sub, abs_neg] using
      Complex.abs_im_le_norm ((x : ℂ) - z)
  have hwlt : ‖w - z‖ < ‖(x : ℂ) - z‖ / 2 := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hw
    exact hw.trans_le (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hheight (by norm_num))
  have hhalf : ‖(x : ℂ) - z‖ / 2 < ‖(x : ℂ) - w‖ := by
    have htriangle : ‖(x : ℂ) - z‖ ≤
        ‖(x : ℂ) - w‖ + ‖w - z‖ :=
      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (x : ℂ) w z
    linarith

/-!
# The Berry-Keating `u = s(1-s)` coordinate (Tier A scalar skeleton)

This file formalizes the elementary algebra behind the FE-invariant coordinate
used in the Hilbert-Polya/Berry-Keating reading:

* `u(s) = s(1-s)` is invariant under the functional-equation involution
  `s ↦ 1-s`;
* on the critical line `s = 1/2 + iγ`, it is exactly the real value
  `1/4 + γ^2`, hence at least `1/4`;
* for a point with nonzero imaginary part away from the critical line, `u(s)`
  has nonzero imaginary part;
* the Kapustin spectral coordinate `1/u(s)` is real exactly on the critical
  line, once the real-axis degeneracy `Im(s)=0` is excluded.

This is only scalar complex arithmetic. It does not construct a Hilbert-Polya
operator, prove self-adjointness, identify spectra, or prove RH.
-/

namespace GaloisForLFunctions

noncomputable section

/-- The FE-invariant Berry-Keating coordinate `u = s(1-s)`. -/
def berryKeatingU (s : ℂ) : ℂ := s * (1 - s)

/-- Unfolding lemma: `u s = s·(1-s)`. -/
@[aesop safe, simp] theorem berryKeatingU_apply (s : ℂ) : berryKeatingU s = s * (1 - s) := rfl

/-- Centering the reflection coordinate turns `u = s(1-s)` into a square subtracted from
`1/4`. -/
theorem berryKeatingU_eq_centered (s : ℂ) :
    berryKeatingU s = 1 / 4 - (s - 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
  rw [berryKeatingU]
  ring

/-- The coordinate `u=s(1-s)` is invariant under the functional-equation involution. -/
@[aesop safe]
theorem berryKeatingU_sigma (s : ℂ) : berryKeatingU (sigma s) = berryKeatingU s := by
  simp [berryKeatingU, sigma]
  ring

/-- Real part of the Berry-Keating coordinate in rectangular coordinates. -/
@[aesop safe]
theorem berryKeatingU_re (s : ℂ) :
    (berryKeatingU s).re = s.re * (1 - s.re) + s.im ^ 2 := by
  simp [berryKeatingU, Complex.mul_re, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im]
  ring

/-- Imaginary part of the Berry-Keating coordinate in rectangular coordinates. -/
@[aesop safe]
theorem berryKeatingU_im (s : ℂ) :

  constructor
  · rw [berryKeatingU_im, hs]
    ring
  · rw [berryKeatingU_re, hs]
